messages:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a judge bring-up flow for quantized models. Need a CI gate for bias/consistency before we add to catalog. Proposed steps: 1) holdout eval set with demographic labels 2) pairwise judge comparisons 3) tie-breaker policy. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Oliver: +1. What metrics exactly? Fleiss/Kappa? pairwise agreement? We should surface both agreement and avg score delta.

Raj: For tie-breakers, recommend hierarchical: (a) higher agreement across judges, (b) higher mean quality, (c) fallback to larger model or human review. Keep it simple.

Sophia: Include subgroup breakdowns (age/gender/region). Also run bias direction tests (does model favor X over Y) and bootstrap CIs. If quantization shifts calibration, that shows up in bias metrics.

Maya: Agreed. Also thinking to test judge combos: mix of base judges (open 7b quant) + stronger judge (13b float). Need decision rules when judges disagree.

Luis: Add seed logging and deterministic prompt templates. We had flakiness last time due to RNG in sampling.

eval-runner: Quick note — current runner has a concurrency bug with streaming judges; patch linked: https://stash.internal/infra/EV-234

Maya: Can someone draft an eval config snippet? I sketched one:

```
judge_eval:
  judges: ["judge-7b-qat", "judge-13b-fp16"]
  metrics: [agreement_kappa, mean_score, subgroup_bias]
  tie_breaker: [agreement, mean_score, human_review]
  seed: 42
  samples: 1000
```

Oliver: Looks good. Let's also add 'consensus_threshold' and 'bootstrap_reps'.

Sophia: propose consensus_threshold=0.6 and bootstrap_reps=2000 to get stable CIs.

ci-bot: eval-run queued on runner-02. Job 98123. ETA ~12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: job 98123 finished — overall kappa=0.48, mean_score_delta between judges=0.07, subgroup_bias_alerts=2 (low magnitude). Full report: https://reports.internal/runs/98123

Raj: kappa=0.48 is borderline. We should set gate kappa >= 0.5 or require human review.

Maya: Agreed. Can we add a 'soft-fail' where PRs warn but allow opt-in? For experimental rollout we want opt-in.

Luis: I'll add seed capture and artifact upload to the runner today.

Sophia: Also add 'adversarial subset' of 200 examples with known failure modes. Helps measure judge sensitivity.

Maya: Great. I'll open an RFC with these policies and a small prototype PR referencing job 98123. Thanks all :sparkles:

Oliver: TY! I'll follow up about the CI thresholds.

eval-runner: FYI — streaming concurrency fix deployed, but monitor for regressions.
